report: Independently verified exact byte equality of current parser.rs, validate.rs, and envelopes.rs against the supplied historical snapshots, then reassessed the current complete claim, both ordinary implementation entries, and the sole ordinary associated test. Parser::method selects Query for query and requires fn for Function, and stores kind in Method. resolve_contracts copies method.kind into each OperationContract; later permission/dispatch construction does not replace it. Captured ContractModel::new/operations confirms the test observes this resolved map. The complete query_and_function_kinds_survive_contract_resolution test declares one of each operation kind and explicitly asserts Query and Function both on parsed methods and on their corresponding resolved operations. Thus either collapsing, swapping, or losing the distinction is detected. Captured parse/valid/class helpers establish that these assertions inspect the parsed, validated fixture. The claim's memoized-semantic-product versus ordinary-computation wording describes boundary metadata, expressly excluding an evaluator/cache; the inspected parser and contract construction preserve this metadata without evaluating methods or memoizing results. It does not require runtime cache behavior or cache tests. There are no TODO/N/A entries or deferred prerequisites. Historical approval was supporting baseline context, not substituted for this assessment. I ran review start, review read, and byte-comparison commands; no behavioral tests or build were run by me. The coordinator separately reports 321 passing functional sage-meta tests and a successful root cargo build. No source changes or requested edits.
